name: Triangle Kush Live Resin Cannon | 1.3g
description: From premium fresh frozen indoor flower to 100% live resin infusion, each Cannon is crafted to perfection, with a full spectrum high terpene extract and custom ceramic 8mm filters, promising a smoking experience that's as intense as it is unforgettable and ensuring a smooth and flavorful ride every time.
